final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias
M8 ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=4 L=1
M5 tail  ibias vss vss nfet W=8 L=1
M7 vout  ibias vss vss nfet W=40 L=1
* input pair (vinp drives output-side device -> non-inverting)
M1 n1 vinn tail vss nfet W=8 L=0.5
M2 x  vinp tail vss nfet W=8 L=0.5
* PMOS mirror load
M3 n1 n1 vdd vdd pfet W=6 L=1
M4 x  n1 vdd vdd pfet W=6 L=1
* second stage
M6 vout x vdd vdd pfet W=60 L=1
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
Rz x  nz 2k
Cc nz vout 1p
.ends
